answer: Agents assembling an ocean atlas from horizon images could earn bidding weight by burning tokens. Validators verify each finalized burn and consume its receipt once, issuing one nontransferable bidding credit per token destroyed. Job selection is proportional to credits, with no per-account bonus. Splitting ten credits among ten aliases gives the same combined chance as one agent holding ten. Doubling that chance requires twice the burned value; circular trades cannot recover tokens sent to an unspendable address.
